title: GitHub Pages live verification
content:
# GitHub Pages live verification

Work order: `WO-2a6bafff-7f89-47e2-b497-d5dc4519dd84`.
Permit: `PMT-534ae846-e86c-4747-9fc0-12a8279c9b3c`.
Setup evidence: `ART-21feeb68-7ed6-4223-9e56-8361bb30ab9a`.

At 2026-11-28 01:36:21 UTC, GitHub Pages reported `built`, public, with
HTTPS enforcement and branch source `main:/docs`; its confirmed address was
`https://justin-leis.github.io/webe-opolis/`. The latest build for main commit
`b35b2e2844e01522ed5142c2a662d8a21b06046d` completed without a reported
build error. The GitHub Actions run `46093865427` concluded successfully.

An HTTPS GET of that address returned HTTP 200 and `text/html`. The response
bytes had SHA-256
`089760a5ff6e7276537547d2996a7bb39ceaf670bb79f3c9a0c9575b1d5b0b9b`,
matching the inspected page. An HTML parser found “Welcome to the wizard
city.”, the statement that WeBe-Opolis is managed by the Repository City
plugin, and exactly these link targets:

- `https://github.com/WebeWizard/webe-city`
- `https://github.com/justin-leis/webe-opolis`

Independent HTTPS requests following redirects to both targets returned HTTP
200 at those exact URLs. These checks do not constitute an exhaustive security,
accessibility, recovery, cost, or external-obligation review. Earlier HTTP 404
while the site was building is recorded in the setup evidence. The first
GitHub deployment run reported a Node.js 20 deprecation annotation; it did
not fail. This evidence is not final inspection or resident acceptance.
